text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah, what the heck. Ow, that hurts.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"My head's been throbbing since this 
morning. I wonder if someone's gossiping 
about me..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what the heck! That's a sneeze!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Ow-ow-ow. Shouting makes my head 
pound. I can't even play the straight man 
like this..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross was plagued by a headache for 
a while, and tried to hold back on her 
retorts.
